_source: Helen Edgar's own playlist, Faery Yurt’s Yarn, on her AutisticRealms channel. Read with yt-dlp --flat-playlist -J on 2026-10-13, in the playlist's own order: twelve entries, and YouTube said one more is hidden as unavailable, which plays for nobody and is not here. Every id below was then opened on its own watch page that day and answered OK and playableInEmbed true, family-safe and not live; each runtime is that page's lengthSeconds (the one under the title, which is the one the pullers read). Helen asked on 2026-10-13, through Ryan, for the yarn to get the rack and for a phonograph in the room.

replaced.why: The playlist's copy, uploaded by AURORA - Topic, answered UNPLAYABLE, Video unavailable, on its watch page on 2026-10-13, and Ryan found it saying so when it played. This is the visualiser on AURORA's own channel, the same song at the same 4:05, OK and playableInEmbed true that day. The playlist itself is Helen's and still has the old copy until she swaps it.
